title: Releases
subtitle: Every release by stage: what it is waiting on, and what it took to ship.
deleteConfirm: Delete release {version}? Its checklist and history go with it. Tasks scoped into it are kept and unscoped.
emptyBody: Nothing in this view. A cycle opens once a product has passed Gate 1.

scope.title: Scope
scope.empty: Nothing is scoped into this release yet. Add the work it is meant to deliver so "ready" means something.
scope.noneAvailable: Every open task on this product is already in a release.

panel.title: Releases
panel.subtitle: The cycles this product ships in.
panel.empty: No releases yet. Plan one to give the next batch of work a date and a checklist.
panel.emptyBody: The MVP appears when the product passes Gate 1. Cycles are planned here after that.
panel.needsGate: Cycles open once the product has passed Gate 1.

form.name: Name
form.notesPlaceholder: What changed, what to watch, what to tell users…

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.empty: This release has no required checks.
checklist.closed: The checklist is closed: this release has already shipped or been cancelled.
checklist.readOnly: Only the product owner or an admin can complete these.

release_notes.label: Release notes written
release_notes.hint: What changed, in language the people affected can read.

qa_signoff.label: QA sign-off
qa_signoff.hint: Someone other than the author has exercised the change.

rollback_plan.label: Rollback plan
rollback_plan.hint: How this gets undone, written down before it is needed.

security_signoff.label: Security sign-off
security_signoff.hint: Required for high-risk products. The review is recorded in the lifecycle.

change_approval.label: Change approval
change_approval.hint: Required for high-risk products. Who agreed this goes out, and when.

advance.title: Move this release
advance.gapsRecorded: This is recorded against the release rather than blocking it.
advance.waiverRequired: A high-risk release cannot ship with gaps unless you write down why.
advance.waiverPlaceholder: Why this ships with the gaps above, and what covers the risk…
advance.openTasks: {count, plural, =1 {1 task still open} other {# tasks still open}}

confirm.planned: Send this release back to planning.
confirm.in_progress: Work on this release is under way.
confirm.ready: Everything is in place and this is ready to go out.
confirm.released: This is going out. The checklist and any gaps are recorded against it permanently.
confirm.rolled_back: This release was pulled back after going out. The record of it shipping is kept.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid: Check the details and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the product owner or an admin can do that.
errors.adminRequired: Only an admin can do this for a high-risk release.
errors.notFound: That release could not be found.
errors.duplicateVersion: That version already exists for this product.
errors.invalidTransition: That change is not allowed from here.
errors.checklistClosed: This release has shipped or been cancelled; its checklist is closed.
errors.releasedImmutable: A shipped release cannot be deleted.
errors.waiverRequired: Write down why this ships with gaps.
errors.stageIncomplete: This stage cannot close yet. See what is still needed.
errors.noteRequired: Add a note for this move.
errors.cannotMoveBack: A shipped release does not move back by stage. Roll it back instead.
errors.notReachedYet: That evidence belongs to a stage the release has not reached.
errors.onlyCurrentStage: Only evidence from the current stage can be removed.
errors.invalidLink: The link must start with https:// or http://.
errors.goalRequired: Give the cycle a one-line goal.
errors.gateOneRequired: Cycles open once the product has passed Gate 1.
errors.cancelled: This release is cancelled. Reopen it first.
errors.rolledBack: This release was rolled back. Reopen it first.
errors.alreadyInStage: The release is already in that stage.
errors.oneStepAtATime: Move one stage at a time.
errors.wrongStage: That happens at a different stage.

stage.waiverHint: High risk ships only with a written reason for what is still open.
stage.adminOnly: Only an admin can move a high-risk release.
stage.ready: Everything this stage needs is in place.
stage.reason: Why is the release going back?
stage.waiver: Waiver: why this ships with the gaps above

cycle.title: New cycle
cycle.subtitle: A version, a one-line goal and a target date. Its stages and evidence follow from the risk tier.

risk.hint: The risk tier decides which evidence a release requires and whether shipping needs a waiver.

approval.title: Spec approval
approval.hint: The release owner approves the spec before it moves to Build.

test.title: Test result
test.hint: Record the outcome. Open findings must be closed before the release can deploy.

artifacts.none: Nothing filed at this stage yet.
artifacts.title: Title
artifacts.removeConfirm: Remove this evidence from the release?
artifacts.carryHint: Carry this into the next release’s intent

confirm.rolled_back: A shipped release is pulled back. Say why; the shipping date is kept.
confirm.in_progress: Fix and ship again from Build.
confirm.planned: Start the loop again from Plan.
